title: Pass editor filenames as literal argv entries

note.title: Pass editor filenames as literal argv entries
answers: How should Click launch an editor with multiple files?
Opening a filename containing quotes or semicolons invokes shell commands.
How do I preserve filenames with shell metacharacters when editing?
note.body:
Symptom: Opening files in the user's editor can interpret quotes and shell metacharacters in filenames as command syntax.
Root cause: src/click/_termui_impl.py:Editor.edit_files previously assembled quoted filenames into a command string passed to a shell.
Fix pattern: Split the configured editor command with shlex.split, append filenames as separate unchanged argv entries, and pass the list to subprocess.Popen without shell=True.
Constraints: Apply splitting only to the editor command, never to filenames; tests/test_termui.py:test_editor_path_normalization verifies that shell metacharacters remain literal filename content.
